primary_source_applied.citation: Livshyts--Paouris--Pivovarov, On sharp bounds for marginal densities of product measures, Israel J. Math. 216 (2016), arXiv:1507.07949
primary_source_applied.scope_used: Every k-dimensional orthogonal marginal of a product of one-dimensional probability densities bounded by one has density cap 2^(k/2); k=2 is used in the terminal cross-block endpoint.

partner_result_applied.actual_use: Iterated recurrence M_j <= 2 |a_j|^(-1/2) M_(j-1)^(1/2) for successive outer physical Schur pivots.

duplicate_scope_detected.scope: rank-two physical cross half-Riesz endpoint constant 8 and one-pivot Schur compiler
duplicate_scope_detected.action: This run's independent rederivation is preserved immutably but is not registered as a new fleet result.

new_result.statement: If a terminal rank-two physical cross residual with singular-value product Delta is preceded by m successive nonzero physical scalar Schur pivots a_1,...,a_m (innermost to outermost), then the output has an L-infinity density bounded by 2^(2+2^(1-m)) Delta^(-1/2^(m+1)) prod_j |a_j|^(-1/2^(m-j+1)).

corrections_consumed: owner/current-research correction: no law-uniform pointwise scalar quadratic Fresnel decay
unresolved_implication: The bare three-large-eigenvalue condition does not force even one good rank-two Schur cross cut. Route rank-one-star/no-good-cross-cut states product-preservingly into grouped, hub, ridge, zero-pivot, or other paid mechanisms.
next_step: Seek a structural dichotomy for the no-good-cross-cut states rather than further optimizing the already-paid rank-two cross endpoint.
